title: Design System: Mera Bhavishya – Mera Nirnay

display.purpose: The programme name on the home hero; also the closing 'Class 10' line and the footer name. English only gets the negative tracking.

headline.purpose: Home section statements and the four staircase steps.

title.purpose: The h1 of each app screen; h2 to h4 step down from it.

lead.purpose: One supporting sentence under a heading, max 52ch.

body.purpose: Running text in Hindi and English; never below 1rem, inputs never below 16px.

label.purpose: Hints, captions, table headers, nav group names, tags.

shadows.name: hairline-ring
shadows.purpose: Every app card, tree node, timeline cell, roster and compare table; replaces borders.

shadows.name: hairline-ring-home
shadows.purpose: Cards on the white home page.

shadows.name: hover-ring
shadows.purpose: Hover on clickable cards and tree leaves.

shadows.name: hover-lift
shadows.purpose: Career and recommendation cards on hover only.

shadows.name: input-ring
shadows.purpose: Input outline at rest; becomes inset 0 0 0 2px #111 on focus.

shadows.name: toast
shadows.purpose: The ink toast floating at the bottom of the screen.

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.purpose: Keyboard focus on every focusable element.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: Default ease-out for state changes, entrances and the picture settle.

motion.name: press
motion.purpose: Buttons, chips, answers and Menu on press.

motion.name: state
motion.purpose: Background, border and ring changes on hover/selection.

motion.name: hero-shutter
motion.value: clip-path inset(0 100% 0 0)→inset(0), 1.1s ease-io; image scale 1.12→1 over 1.4s ease
motion.purpose: Signature: the road opens inside the programme name once the image has loaded.

motion.name: rise-in
motion.purpose: One-time entrance of home section parts as they scroll in (IntersectionObserver).

motion.name: meter-grow
motion.purpose: Fit meters and result bars filling on first render.

motion.name: toast
motion.purpose: Toast lifetime; becomes a plain fade under reduced motion.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Transitions limited to colour/opacity; no press scale, no shutter (picture shown open), no rise, no bar growth, no menu slide. Print always shows everything.

breakpoints.name: phone
breakpoints.purpose: max-width: single column, 16px gutter, hero picture on its own line

breakpoints.name: topline-links-off
breakpoints.purpose: max-width: home top-line links hidden (Menu remains)

breakpoints.name: tablet
breakpoints.purpose: max-width: grids to two columns, detail pages to one

breakpoints.name: sidebar
breakpoints.purpose: min-width: fixed 248px app sidebar; below it a 56px app bar and full-screen menu

breakpoints.name: topline-compact
breakpoints.purpose: max-width: home top line shows three links

print.reportCard: Two A4 portrait sheets per student (certificate front + career profile back), @page margin 0, each sheet zoomed to fit the printable area so the set is always exactly two pages.
print.certificateFront: Ink double frame (1.2mm solid + 0.35mm outline offset -3mm), Haryana emblem header and 5% emblem watermark, name over an ink rule, signature lines and a dashed seal circle.
print.profileBack: 4mm ink top band, emblem header over an ink rule, white boxes with #c9d0da borders and 1.2mm corners.
print.screens: Results, plan and class lists print at 11pt on white with cards as 1px #999 boxes and links in black.

imagery.source: Six Figma AI illustrations (road, cycle, nursing, iti, classroom, computers) in public/img as 640/1280 WebP, each with a .webp.json provenance sidecar.
imagery.labelling: Footer on the home page states the pictures are illustrations made with Figma AI, not real students or schools.

brandAssets.name: Haryana Government emblem
brandAssets.use: Sidebar/top-line wordmark, menu sheet, both printed sheets; kept as a binding brand asset.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Near-black pill for the main action on any app screen.

narrative.overview:
The programme's own name is the composition. On the home page "मेरा भविष्य / मेरा निर्णय" is set at poster scale on two lines, and a picture of a country road through mustard fields sits inside the second line where a letter would be. The rest of the home page repeats that grammar at smaller scale: a short sentence on the left, its evidence (a picture, a list of dates, a row of facts) beside it. Every app screen (assessment, results, career tree, directories, class session) drops the poster scale and becomes an achromatic ledger: ink figures on white cards over a pale blue-grey ground, with the one blue kept for the number or bar that matters most on that screen.

The look is neutral and official without borrowing the government-portal template. There is no utility bar, no row of blue buttons on white, no ruled link lists, no icon-card grids and no edtech gradient. Authority comes from the Haryana emblem, plain bilingual words and an even, quiet surface. Density is sparse on the home page (very large type, long vertical breaks) and moderate in the app (44px controls, 1rem gaps, white cards).

The system is built for a student on a low-end Android phone, reading Hindi first, often offline, and for a teacher printing a whole class's report cards on an ordinary black-and-white A4 printer. Everything has to read in Hindi and English with the same face, survive missing web fonts, and print legibly without colour.
keyCharacteristics: One face, Anek Devanagari, for Hindi and English alike.
Ink and greys everywhere; one blue, used on the home action and on each screen's main data element.
Near-black pill buttons for primary actions, grey pills for secondary ones.
White cards (8px corners) and controls (6px corners) defined by a hairline ring, not by shadow.
Home is a white page with a top line of links; app screens sit on a pale ground with a sidebar.
One signature motion: the road picture opens inside the name like a shutter.
The printed report card is a first-class product: two A4 sheets in the same ink look.

rules.name: The One Blue Rule
rules.body: Road Blue appears on the home page's main action and on the single main data element of a screen. Nothing else in the chrome is coloured: navigation, headers, cards and secondary buttons stay ink and grey.

rules.name: The Black-and-White Print Rule
rules.body: Anything that prints (results, plan, class list, report card) must still read when printed in greyscale; colour may reinforce meaning but never carry it alone.

rules.name: The Same Voice Rule
rules.body: Hindi and English are set in the same face at the same size and weight. Negative tracking (−0.02em to −0.045em) is applied to large English headings only (`html[lang=en]`); Devanagari is never tracked, because tightening breaks its headline bar.

rules.name: The Plain Weight Rule
rules.body: Headings are 600; emphasis inside text is 600; body is 400. No 800/900 weights, no italics for emphasis, no all-caps interface labels. The one exception is the printed certificate's spaced-caps "CERTIFICATE OF PARTICIPATION" line, a convention of the document form.

rules.name: The Tabular Figures Rule
rules.body: Counts, percentages, dates and roll numbers use tabular figures so columns of numbers line up.

rules.name: The Statement and Proof Rule
rules.body: Each home section is a short sentence on the left with its evidence beside it. A section that needs an icon grid to explain itself is rewritten as a sentence instead.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest; depth comes from white on pale ground and a hairline. A shadow appears only on hover of a card that opens something, or on a transient toast.

dos: Do keep the chrome ink and grey: Ink (#111111) text, Pill Grey (#e6e7e9) secondaries, Ledger Ground (#f2f4f7) behind app screens.
Do give each screen at most one blue element: its main data (progress, fit meter, result bar) or, on home, the start pill.
Do set Hindi and English in Anek Devanagari at the same size and weight, with the Noto and system fallbacks in place.
Do use near-black pills for primary actions and grey pills for secondary ones, at least 44px tall.
Do use 8px corners for cards and 6px for controls and inner panels.
Do keep the Haryana emblem in the header and on both printed sheets.
Do label generated pictures as illustrations and keep their provenance file beside them.
Do provide a still state for every motion under `prefers-reduced-motion`.
donts: Don't add a utility bar, rows of blue buttons on white, ruled link lists or grids of icon cards.
Don't use gradients, tinted panels with coloured borders, or decorative shadows.
Don't colour navigation, headers, cards or secondary buttons.
Don't track Devanagari or set interface labels in all caps.
Don't use photographs of real students, schools or colleges, or invent testimonials or usage numbers.
Don't let colour alone carry meaning on anything that prints.
